heading: INT. NIGHT TRAIN DINING CAR - NIGHT

units.text: INT. NIGHT TRAIN DINING CAR - NIGHT
A narrow dining car, white tablecloths, brass lamps.
The rails clack beneath.
Outside the window, the dark country streams by.
CAPTAIN LEOPOLD "POLLY" SCHRADER, 50s, stout, a retired customs officer in a three-piece suit, cuts into a steak with ceremony.
Across from him, MISS VERONIKA HAAS, 30s, silver cigarette holder, sips from a thin glass and watches him over the rim.
At the next table, alone, sits their waiter-turned-witness, KAZIMIR "KAZ" BLUME, 20s, in a white jacket, polishing the same spoon for the fourth time.
You don't eat, Miss Haas.
units.name: POLLY

units.text: I never do at night.
units.name: VERONIKA

units.text: A woman who doesn't eat at night is a woman with something on her mind.
units.name: POLLY

units.text: Or on her conscience.
units.name: VERONIKA

units.text: The train lurches.
Her glass slides an inch.
Polly catches it before it falls, and holds it a moment too long in his hand.
Careful.
units.name: POLLY

units.text: Thank you, Captain.
units.name: VERONIKA

units.text: Sir, if I may. The steak. Is it satisfactory?
units.name: KAZ

units.text: Kaz, my boy, the steak is excellent.
units.name: POLLY

units.text: I'm glad, sir. I prepared it myself.
units.name: KAZ

units.text: Polly's knife stops.
Did you.
units.name: POLLY

units.text: It was the last of the lot. The cook was indisposed.
units.name: KAZ

units.text: Veronika sets her glass down very softly.
The lamps shake.
The knife rests on the plate.
Polly dabs his lips with a napkin, rises to his full, unsteady height, and clutches the table.
Veronika. I feel--
units.name: POLLY

units.text: She is already on her feet.
She catches his arm as he buckles, easing him into the chair.
Kaz has put down the spoon.
Kaz. The window.
units.name: VERONIKA

units.text: Yes, miss.
units.name: KAZ

units.text: He slides the sash up.
Night air floods the car.
Polly breathes, hard, his eyes on her.
Veronika. The steak.
units.name: POLLY

units.text: I know, Polly.
units.name: VERONIKA

units.text: You?
units.name: POLLY

units.text: Not me, darling.
units.name: VERONIKA

units.text: She turns, slowly, to Kaz, who stands in the open window with the spoon in his hand and a different expression than before.
Miss Haas. You weren't meant to be at this table.
units.name: KAZ
